scope: Optional normal target sampler per-request seed support without global deterministic inference
limitations: Does not enable DFLASH request seeds; DFLASH guard still rejects them
Seeded batches use stock PyTorch full-vocabulary sort for top-p; no throughput claim
Mixed unseeded rows retain ordinary categorical draws; seeded batches pay an extra categorical draw to avoid CPU synchronization
min_p plus seed remains upstream unsupported; Kimi catalog does not advertise min_p
Model-kernel numerical determinism across batching is not guaranteed without global deterministic inference; seed controls sampling randomness only
